request.objective: Generate ONE complete FRONT ORTHOGRAPHIC low polygon cream-painted wooden museum door leaf matching the European/Renaissance doorway in references1 and2. The real leaf has TWO rectangular recessed panels: a very tall upper panel occupying approximately60 percent of the leaf height and a much shorter lower panel occupying approximately23 percent, with broad plain rails/stiles and subtle stepped raised panel mouldings.
